description: Olwacholi lulimi lwa Luo olwogerwa abantu ng’akakade kamu n’ekitundu mu bukiikakono bwa Uganda, okwetoolola Gulu, Kitgum ne Pader, n’emitala w’ensalo mu South Sudan.
notes: Drafted by Claude (AI) for the Acholi courses (#130) with low confidence in Acholi; needs a native-speaker review. The Lusoga needs a native-speaker review too; word and unit notes fall back to the English notes (lang/en/about/ach).

why.title: Olulimi lwa **Gulu, Kitgum n’obukiikakono.**
why.text: Olwacholi lwogerwa mu bukiikakono bwa Uganda yonna era lufaanana n’Olulango, Olwalur n’Olujaluo lw’e Kenya, atyanu bw’oluyiga oigula enimi dha Luo inhi. Luyige olw’ab’eka, entambula, emirimu, n’enyimba, amazina n’engero dh’obukiikakono.

cards.title: Ku lw’ab’eka
cards.text: Yogera ne badhaadha n’ab’eka e Gulu ne Kitgum.

cards.title: Ku lw’abatambuli
cards.text: Tambula okuva e Gulu okutuuka e Kitgum, Pader ne ku Kiira e Karuma.

cards.title: Ku lw’abeegomba okumanya
cards.text: Bona olulimi lwa Luo oluliko amaloboozi agalinya n’okuka, enukuta empanvu n’empimpi, era nga teruliko bika bya manya.

landing.audience: Aboogera Olusoga abatandika okuva ku ntandikwa, ab’eka abava mu Acholi, n’abatambuli abagenda mu bukiikakono bwa Uganda.
landing.first: Okulamusa, okweyanjula n’enamba, oluvanyuma ab’omu maka, emere, akatale, esaawa, ebifo, awaka n’obulamu, ekitundu ku kitundu.

cast.emma: Omugenyi ayiga Olwacholi nga tanaba kutambula
